note: Own binding rules, not an original WAI-ARIA schema.
instanceIdentity: Replace instance-* placeholders with stable unique IDs per component instance.
label: Visible label for control; placeholder never substitutes for it.
descriptions: Reference only actually rendered nonempty hint/error IDs via aria-describedby.
invalid: Set aria-invalid only for an actual host validation error.
nativeSemantics: Use native input with declared inputType, autocompleteHint, required, disabled and readOnly mappings. type=tel does not validate international numbers.
required: Map to native required attribute; form validity is not proven by SCXML alone.
